correctness.rationale: Conditioning at R=-(T/2)log cosh(2G/T) exactly decouples both Ising legs, whose ordered even moments are products of rho to alternate gaps. The conditional apex mean u(A+B)/2 gives four-distinct moment u^4 rho^(g1+g3)(1+rho^(2g2))/4, and cumulant subtraction gives -u^4 rho^(g1+2g2+g3)/4. All four-fold index multiplicities are accounted for in the formula, and absolute summability holds for 0<rho<1. A separate finite-periodic transfer-matrix derivative computation and a direct chain-index enumeration support the proof with 38 tests; nonstandard claims are proved analytically, not inferred from finite tests. The strong-leg e^(6J/T) equivalent has coefficient -3u^4/8.
